extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Hillsborough County has a $20 monthly premium, a $255 drug deductible and a $5000 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. The call was focused on finding a plan with the lowest premium, and the agent provided a plan with a $20 monthly premium, $255 drug deductible, and $5000 maximum out-of-pocket.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika did a great job following all the necessary steps and ensuring the call was compliant. One area for improvement could be to provide more context around the network of doctors and pharmacies, as the customer seemed interested in keeping their current providers.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment, plan review in 5 days
